fingerprints.warning_type: ["A01:2017 - Injection", "A03:2021 - Injection"] / ["CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')"]
fingerprints.message: User data flows into this manually-constructed SQL string. User data can be safely inserted into SQL strings using prepared statements or an object-relational mapper (ORM). Manually-constructed SQL strings is a possible indicator of SQL injection, which could let an attacker steal or manipulate data from the database. Instead, use prepared statements (`$mysqli->prepare("INSERT INTO test(id, label) VALUES (?, ?)");`) or a safe library.

fingerprints.warning_type: ["A07:2017 - Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)", "A03:2021 - Injection"] / ["CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')"]
fingerprints.message: `Echo`ing user input risks cross-site scripting vulnerability. You should use `htmlentities()` when showing data to users.
